lead_raw_text:
The structure of Nd2Al3 crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 10 atoms (Nd4Al6) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al centers with 12 geometric neighbors (6 Al, 6 Nd) and Nd centers with 18 neighbors (12 Al, 6 Nd), with a single three-dimensional geometric neighbor graph spanning all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner- and face-sharing between Al 12-vertex and Nd 18-vertex polyhedra, and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Nd polyhedra.
